howto.name: Upload a PDF with bookmarks
howto.text: Drop a PDF whose Table of Contents uses bookmarks to mark chapters/sections.

howto.name: PrivaTools splits at every top-level bookmark
howto.text: Each section between consecutive bookmarks becomes its own PDF file.

howto.name: Download the ZIP
howto.text: Each chapter is named after its bookmark text (sanitized for filesystem safety).

faq.q: What if the PDF has no bookmarks?
faq.a: The tool returns an error. Use the regular Split tool or the new Split by Text tool which doesn't need bookmarks.
No — only top-level bookmarks define split points. Sub-sections stay within their parent chapter PDF.

faq.q: Can I include the bookmark title as the PDF title?
faq.a: Each output PDF inherits its starting bookmark's title as the file name. The internal PDF Title metadata is set to match.
